title: Game Night at the Farm
paras: People in Moss End have a new way to spend Friday evenings. They go to a farm to play football, not to buy milk. Last month, six people came. Now there are [[forty|forty]] [[player|players]]. Most are over fifty. Some have never liked [[sport|sport]] before. But they enjoy these games. They come after work, and some bring their families to watch.

The games are different here. The field is [[small|small]], and each game lasts ten minutes. The [[ball|ball]] is soft and easy to kick. Its [[size|size]] helps people see it: it is bigger than a normal football. A brown [[cow|cow]] often watches from the next field. Farm owner Amara tells new people, "This is not an [[exam|exam]]. You do not need to be good. Just have fun."

After the games, everyone sits under an apple tree for a [[picnic|picnic]]. They share bread, fruit and [[chocolate|chocolate]]. There are no prizes for winning. At first, Luis came only for the food. Now he brings his football shoes every week. "I still like the meal," he says. "But these days, I want to play first."
zh: 莫斯恩德村的人们有了度过周五晚上的新方式。他们去一家农场踢足球，而不是买牛奶。上个月只有六个人来，现在有四十名参与者。大多数人都超过五十岁。有些人以前从不喜欢体育运动，但他们很喜欢这里的比赛。他们下班后过来，有些人还带着家人来看。
这里的比赛不太一样。场地很小，每场比赛只持续十分钟。球很软，很容易踢。它的大小让人们容易看清：它比普通足球更大。一头棕色奶牛常常从旁边的田里看着大家。农场主人阿玛拉告诉新来的人：“这不是考试。你不必踢得很好，开心就行。”
比赛结束后，大家坐在一棵苹果树下野餐。他们分享面包、水果和巧克力。赢了比赛也没有奖品。起初，路易斯只是为了吃东西才来。现在，他每周都带着足球鞋来。“我还是喜欢这顿饭，”他说，“但现在，我想先踢球。”

q.s: More people take part now than last month.
q.why: 上个月六人参加，现在有四十人。

q.s: The farm uses a football that is smaller than usual.
q.why: 文中说用球比普通足球更大。

q.s: Amara makes the bread for the meal after the games.
q.why: 文中提到分享面包，未说是谁做的。
